selection_rationale.objective: Prefer one dense no-lookback point-in-time mechanism on an economic axis not already represented by return paths, volatility, activity timing, accounting quality, disclosure timing, or old-factor combinations.
selection_rationale.economic_anchor: For ordinary A-share buy orders the 100-share board lot makes nominal CNY share price a direct determinant of minimum order notional; lower nominal price therefore represents greater retail lot affordability without requiring market capitalization or shares-outstanding data.

rejected_before_values.reason: Campaign066-Campaign072 already exposed balance, scale, acceleration, transition, spread, and joint-growth operators; another field/operator permutation would be same-family search.
The frozen return-variance-entropy family already rejected these as same-mechanism transforms of squared-return concentration.
Historical one-minute opening-price semantics are not uniform and the prior opening-gap protocol is terminally excluded.
Backward adjustment can import future corporate-action information, while market capitalization and shares outstanding are not frozen source fields; no proxy or imputation is allowed.
Choosing among price anchors or clock windows would create a parameter search. Only the exact 15:00 terminal continuous-session close is selected.
Thresholds, subsets, regimes, terminal-factor inputs, fitted weights, and models are outside Campaign073.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_terminal_nominal_share_price_affordability_rank_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A lower completed-session nominal share price reduces the cash required for one 100-share board lot and may broaden short-horizon retail participation; the resulting affordability state may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For every accepted stock day, require the exact 240 continuous-auction closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, take the positive finite 15:00 close p, compute its same-day average-tie cross-sectional percentile rank r_price on the exact finite candidate identity universe, and return 1-r_price.
selected_candidate.accepted_grid: Exactly 120 closes at 09:31-11:30 and 120 closes at 13:01-15:00; standalone 09:30 is excluded and no lunch return is formed.
selected_candidate.price_anchor: The raw point-in-time positive finite 15:00 CNY close from the completed signal session.
selected_candidate.corporate_action_rule: Use the contemporaneously observed nominal CNY close exactly as captured; do not back-adjust, forward-adjust, splice, rescale, or compare across dates.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each accepted stock day compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile rank over exactly the finite terminal closes on the candidate stock-day identity cross-section, then subtract from one.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless the exact 240-bar continuous-session grid is present, every selected close is positive and finite, the terminal close is finite, and the same-day affordability rank is finite. Never impute, adjust, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, or choose another price anchor.
